evidence.suspension_mechanism: Account suspension/termination via automated enforcement + human review
evidence.appeal_process: Appeal via X Help Center; limited transparency on criteria
evidence.oversight_board: Meta Oversight Board handles select cases (Meta platforms only)
evidence.transparency_reports: Community Standards Enforcement Report shows enforcement volumes
evidence.government_requests: Government Requests for User Data report published semiannually

impact.description: Account suspensions can occur without clear due process. Appeal mechanism exists but criteria opaque. Oversight Board only for Meta platforms, not X. Government requests for user data show state pressure on platform decisions.

remediation.notes: No independent appeals body for X (Twitter) specifically
